title: How to get real variety from AI, not 20 of the same
seoTitle: Get real variety from AI, not 20 of the same
description: Why AI repeats itself, and how to get options that really differ: list the kinds first, pick a mix, use one maker per kind, then run a sameness check.
lede: Ask an AI for twenty ideas and you often get one idea twenty times. This guide shows you how to get real variety: different kinds of work, a mix you choose, and a check that catches the copies.
